chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام passed by some people while they were eating locusts, and he said:
"Glory be to Allah, while you are in the state of ihram?"
They said, "It is only from the sea."
He said, "Then dip it in the water, then."

key_terms.الْبَحْرِ: The sea, invoked here as a claimed legal category
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: Water, mentioned in the Imam’s rebuttal
key_terms.جَرَادًا: Locusts being eaten in the report
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ: An expression of astonishment and glorification of Allah
key_terms.مُحْرِمُونَ: Those who are in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim eat locusts by claiming they are from the sea?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal rebuke regarding eating locusts while in the state of ihram. Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام rejects the claim that locusts are considered sea game, using a concise response to show that such reasoning is invalid.
